description: This file defines transport mechanisms and configuration resolution for MCP (Machine Communication Protocol) transports, including functions to attach stderr logging, build SSE event source fetch, and resolve transport configurations into transport instances.

methods.name: attachStderrLogging
methods.description: Attaches a data event listener to stderr of a StdioClientTransport to log stderr output.

methods.name: buildSseEventSourceFetch
methods.description: Creates a fetch function that includes custom headers for SSE event source.

methods.name: resolveMcpTransport
methods.description: Resolves a server configuration into a specific MCP transport instance based on its type.
